findings.issue: One historical quiet label conflicts with a literal threshold boundary
findings.owner_quiet_rule: absolute movement below 10 percent without a severe operational incident
findings.resolution: Flagged for owner/register review. Neither the label nor original score was silently changed.

claim_limits: Owner policy and labeled historical examples are supplied; this is not zero-context or real-human usability evidence.
Live Jev and a real local binary/MCP were used; company sources were read-only synthetic MCP replays, not new warehouse reads.
Native routing and required-source presence do not prove numeric explanation quality, causal correctness, customer adoption or advantage over Luna.
The local binary is a development build, not a newly published release or managed-device installation certification.
